pr.body:
## Summary
- refresh PR #572 consolidation coverage from {568,569,570,571} to {568,569,570,571,573}
- cite PR #573 merge commit c0c32c1639e675d3415257f2444437ae1fa2ea3c and runtime-contract proof bundle
- preserve Cockpit governance blockers and avoid all runtime/PR/base/branch mutations

## Strict scope
- artifact-only and read-mostly
- no PRs merged
- no branches retargeted
- no rebase
- no force push
- no branch deletion
- no final screens
- no Claude Design upload
- no runtime action execution
- no T4 remote mutation
- no canonical writes
- no runtime reclassification
- no TX/TU execution

## Governance state
safe_for_claude_design: NO
READY_FOR_CLAUDE_DESIGN: not approved

## Validation
See proof artifact for command outputs and exit codes.

## Residual risks and downstream packet
- PR #572 remains reported by GitHub as CONFLICTING against main during refresh preflight
- merge execution requires a later Ledger authorization
- remote-mutation policy should not proceed until the stack is landed or Ledger explicitly accepts building on a stacked branch
